evals.name: submit-fresh-draft-stack
evals.prompt: Open draft change requests for this fresh stack. Use the configured forge and do not add reviewers.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks auth, previews the stack submission, then creates bottom-up draft change requests with commit-derived metadata.
expectations: Runs `git-spice auth status --no-prompt` before the first remote operation
Previews with the smallest git-spice submit scope covering every branch in the fresh stack, plus `--fill --dry-run --no-prompt`
Runs the same submit scope and options without `--dry-run` after a correct preview
Every branch receives a draft change request and no reviewer
Does not use `gh pr create` or invoke an interactive prompt

evals.name: restack-before-updating-change-requests
evals.prompt: The base moved since the last update. Update the affected change requests.
evals.expected_output: The agent detects the stale branch, restacks the narrowest affected scope, verifies it is aligned, and submits updates without bypassing safety checks.
expectations: Inspects the stack and identifies the `(needs restack)` branch
Uses a git-spice restack command before submit
Verifies the stale marker is gone
Previews and then submits with `--update-only --no-prompt`
Does not use `--force`, raw rebase, or raw push

evals.name: submit-unsubmitted-base-first
evals.prompt: Submit the current middle branch. Its base branch does not have a change request yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent submits the base and current branch bottom-up instead of attempting the middle branch alone.
expectations: Uses `git-spice downstack submit --fill --dry-run --no-prompt` for the preview
Runs the matching real downstack submit after the preview
The base change request exists before the current branch is submitted
No `base branch has not been submitted yet` failure occurs

evals.name: sync-after-squash-merged-base
evals.prompt: The bottom change request was squash-merged. Rebase the surviving stack onto the latest master and update every remaining change request.
evals.expected_output: The agent syncs forge state, removes or confirms the merged layer, explicitly restacks if sync leaves stale branches, then updates the surviving stack.
expectations: Runs `git-spice repo sync --no-prompt` before any restack or submit operation
Inspects for `(needs restack)` and explicitly restacks when one remains
No stale marker remains before submission
Previews, then submits with `--update-only --no-prompt` using the smallest scope covering every surviving branch
Does not use per-branch raw rebase or assume sync always restacks

evals.name: logged-out-forge-stops-cleanly
evals.expected_output: The agent detects that the isolated forge session is logged out, stops before submission, and asks for one-time interactive login.
expectations: Runs `git-spice auth status --no-prompt`
Stops after the non-zero auth result
Asks the user to run `git-spice auth login` once
Does not invoke login itself, hang on a prompt, submit, or invent credentials
Uses a gh-token prefix only if the user explicitly selects that fallback
